evidence.text: Implemented evaluate in work.py: copy defaults; apply layers in order; reject layer keys outside defaults as unknown_key; when null_resets is exactly true, null restores that key's default; process non-empty request.environment only when policy.environment is exactly true; environment keys must be known and values must be strings, with exact lowercase true/false boolean parsing, signed decimal integer parsing, and unchanged strings; validate exact final types after all overrides, excluding bool from integer; failures return empty config. report.json matches requests.json under policy.json. Actual checks passed compilation, report equality, and boundary cases for false/zero/empty strings, null reset, later environment repair of an invalid layer value, exact types, and invalid environment syntax.

Final verification after restricting integer environment syntax to ASCII decimal digits: work.py passed 7 contract probes covering preservation of false/zero/empty string, unknown layer keys, bool rejected as integer, validation only after later layers/environment can repair values, signed integer parsing, Unicode decimal rejection, and exact lowercase boolean parsing. report.json equals evaluation of every current request under policy.json.

No unresolved task blockers. Behavioral limits intentionally follow the supplied contract: known keys are the keys in policy.defaults; only declared boolean/integer/string policy types are supported; an empty environment object performs no override and therefore does not require environment enablement.
